minor_findings.summary: A few Unicode presentation details are normalized.
minor_findings.evidence: The candidate changes the title separators from em dashes to en dashes, renders the full-width ６ as ASCII 6 in the yield and custard label, and capitalizes Greek Καραμέλα in the final label where the original uses lowercase καραμέλα.

rationale: All recipe facts, multilingual ingredients, setup requirements, four-operation flow, timing, temperatures, completion criteria, and final role are preserved. The differences are typographic and casing changes that do not alter meaning.
